acceptance: evolve gc reads .evolve/dispatch-trees once per run and shares the result between the process pass and the tree pass.
The only-the-tag-proof-applies WARN prints once per tagged process per run, not once per pass.
fix: Load the dispatch tree records once into a run-scoped cache that both gc passes read.
summary: After the dispatch-hygiene follow-ups, evolve gc reads the dispatch tree directory twice per run (process pass and tree pass) and repeats the only-the-tag-proof-applies WARN for each tagged process on each pass, which doubles the I/O and the log noise.
title: gc reads the dispatch tree records once per run
